submit.command:
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --account=jhpce
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:l40s:1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=10
#SBATCH --mem=96G
#SBATCH --time=3-00:00:00
#SBATCH --signal=B:TERM@300
#SBATCH --no-requeue
set -euo pipefail
SCR="/fastscratch/myscratch/$USER/wcd"
JOBDIR="$SCR/prod/job_${SLURM_JOB_ID}"
mkdir -p "$JOBDIR/x1_inputs"
printf "%s  %s\n" 5dd65550fdb18e5c80e73dcfa731d72bdeb6128bdeac7ffb36df6c54450396ff paper_manifest_stock_pilot_u5_b10_v3.pilot5.tsv 32532edd410d4a93a20d80d1792595090b9630f4df3d1b87d98be0a907756f47 pilot5_jhpce_atac_large.tags | sha256sum -c --quiet
cp paper_manifest_stock_pilot_u5_b10_v3.pilot5.tsv pilot5_jhpce_atac_large.tags "$JOBDIR/x1_inputs/"
git clone -q --no-checkout "$PWD/wcd.bundle" "$JOBDIR/repo"
git -C "$JOBDIR/repo" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout -q 10a1ca5874fbcdc033b148525b5e71d866306bdb
rc=0
bash "$JOBDIR/repo/cluster/jhpce/prod_fit_job.sh" --expected-sha 10a1ca5874fbcdc033b148525b5e71d866306bdb --stage pilot5_jhpce --tags-file ../x1_inputs/pilot5_jhpce_atac_large.tags --tags-sha256 32532edd410d4a93a20d80d1792595090b9630f4df3d1b87d98be0a907756f47 --manifest ../x1_inputs/paper_manifest_stock_pilot_u5_b10_v3.pilot5.tsv --manifest-sha256 5dd65550fdb18e5c80e73dcfa731d72bdeb6128bdeac7ffb36df6c54450396ff --experiments A1 --tasks atac_large --fit-lanes 8 --fit-timeout-s 28800 --max-attempts 2 --guard-margin-s 2700 --slots 5 || rc=$?
for f in "$JOBDIR/logs/job_summary.json" "$JOBDIR/harvest.json"; do [ ! -f "$f" ] || cp "$f" .; done   # KB-sized; the harvest stays on fastscratch
ls -l .
exit "$rc"
